description_en: Call the DescribeProcessList operation to retrieve running queries on an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse Community-Compatible cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeProcessList接口查询云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群正在运行的查询
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse describe-process-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-bp1190tj036am0000 --query-duration-ms 500 --initial-user user --keyword join --order elapsed --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --initial-query-id 6c69d508-f05f-4c74-857c-d982b7e7e79f --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeProcessList

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to find the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to find information about all clusters in the destination region, including the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html接口查询目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The shortest query duration. The minimum value is 1000. The default value is 1000. The unit is milliseconds. The response returns queries that run longer than this duration
parameters.help_zh: 最短的查询耗时。最小值为1000，默认值为1000。单位：毫秒。返回参数将返回超过该耗时的查询
parameters.name: query_duration_ms

parameters.help_en:
The column to use for sorting. Valid values:

elapsed: The total running time.

written_rows: The number of rows written.

read_rows: The number of rows read.

memory_usage: The amount of memory used
parameters.help_zh:
按指定列名排序，取值：
elapsed：累计执行时间
written_rows：写入行数
read_rows：读取行数
memory_usage：内存使用量
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30 (Default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为：大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number
